summary: Atlus and Cozi's PlayStation tactical RPG, also known as The Legend of Kartia, built around two story routes and card-like Kartia magic.

entries.title: Kartia: The Word of Fate

emulation.notes: Use high internal resolution and PGXP; keep the original 4:3 presentation for accuracy.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Upscaled PlayStation assets and geometry through DuckStation.

primary.why: The original PlayStation release is the core version of this standalone tactical RPG; emulator upscaling gives the cleanest capture while preserving the original content.
primary.how_to_play: Use an original disc or legally dumped image in DuckStation with high internal resolution, PGXP geometry correction, and widescreen disabled unless a verified patch is desired.

entries.remaster_caveats: No official remake or remaster documented.
